title: Preserving morphology while extracting DNA: a non-destructive field-to-museum protocol for slide-mounted specimens
author: Jaume-Schinkel, Santiago
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Dehydrate specimens on slide
steps.instruction: Perform dehydration by immersing the slide‑mounted specimens sequentially in ethanol solutions of varying concentrations, then transfer to clove oil, timing each immersion for the specified number of minutes (m).

substeps.instruction: Immerse in graded ethanol series for m minutes each
Transfer to clove oil for m minutes

steps.title: Prepare slide and dissect
steps.instruction: Set up the microscope slide and carefully dissect the mounted specimens as required.

steps.title: Dry euparal for 24 h
steps.instruction: Allow the euparal mounting medium to dry for a continuous 24‑hour period, then verify that all dissected body parts remain in the correct positions.

steps.title: Place cover glasses and dry
steps.instruction: Place cover glasses over the dried preparation and complete any final drying steps.
